record: City Landmark 92, 10 Art Museum Drive, Ordinance 87-1157
facts: Six Ionic limestone columns support the pediment, reached by a terraced stair. Jacobs Wing, Antioch Court and the auditorium were designed in 1936. May, Woodward and Cone Wings were added in the 1950s.
John Russell Pope designed the museum building that opened in 1929.
Historic entrance faces Art Museum Drive. The contemporary entrance and Wyman Park routes belong to other parts of the complex.
